_comment: Every group is OWED until the same proposed cases run in all four named suites.
The core live flow is green in all four frameworks; the adversarial groups below remain OWED until every named case has a real witness.
Primary proof uses a real standards-compliant OIDC provider and real Tina4 Sessions; no mocks or fake OIDC server.

invariants.rule: Issuer configuration and discovery metadata drive the runtime; exact issuer and required endpoints fail closed.

proposed_cases.name: real provider issuer discovers every required endpoint
proposed_cases.then: metadata supplies the flow without a provider adapter

proposed_cases.name: mismatched discovery issuer fails before login

invariants.rule: Login uses code plus PKCE S256 and one-use state/nonce stored in Session; return targets are local paths.

proposed_cases.name: login redirects to real provider with code and pkce s256
proposed_cases.then: authorization request carries code state nonce and S256

proposed_cases.name: external return target falls back to slash
proposed_cases.given: an absolute or protocol-relative external URL

invariants.rule: A verified callback consumes pending material, regenerates Session and atomically stores reserved SSO identity and credentials.

proposed_cases.name: valid callback rotates session and preserves deliberate state
proposed_cases.given: real OIDC provider login plus pre-login cart data
proposed_cases.then: id changes old id dies cart remains identity exists

proposed_cases.name: sso internals never appear in session all

invariants.rule: A later request with only the Tina4 Session cookie restores request.user before the existing Auth gate.

proposed_cases.name: session cookie authenticates an existing secured route
proposed_cases.given: completed login and no Authorization header

proposed_cases.name: unknown session cannot restore sso identity

invariants.rule: Provider claims map to the same identity; provider realm/client roles and groups are unique sorted strings.

proposed_cases.name: realm and target client roles merge deterministically
proposed_cases.given: overlapping roles and groups plus another clients roles
proposed_cases.then: expected unique sorted values exclude other client

proposed_cases.name: configured generic claim map produces the same identity

invariants.rule: Wrong issuer/audience, inactive/expired tokens, bad state and replay create no authenticated Session.

proposed_cases.name: wrong issuer audience and revoked token fail callback
proposed_cases.given: real tokens from a second realm/client and a revoked token

proposed_cases.name: bad state and replayed callback fail
proposed_cases.given: wrong state then consumed real callback
proposed_cases.then: both fail and pending data is gone

invariants.rule: Expiry triggers one refresh; rotated credentials replace the old set atomically, while failure clears authentication.

proposed_cases.name: expired access token refreshes the same session
proposed_cases.then: one refresh succeeds and rotated refresh token is retained
proposed_cases.mutation_witness: retain old refresh token then refresh twice

proposed_cases.name: failed refresh clears sso authentication
proposed_cases.then: secured route denies and credentials are removed

invariants.rule: Logout destroys local Session/cookie first and then provider Session when advertised; remote failure cannot preserve local auth.

proposed_cases.name: logout destroys local and provider sessions
proposed_cases.then: cookie expires old id fails and provider prompts again

proposed_cases.name: provider logout failure cannot preserve local session
proposed_cases.then: old Session cannot access secured route
proposed_cases.mutation_witness: destroy local Session after remote call

invariants.rule: Login, resume, refresh and logout use only Session's public contract and behave identically on file and non-file providers.

proposed_cases.name: sso handoff is identical on file and redis sessions
proposed_cases.given: real OIDC provider and each real Session backend

witness_must_resolve.symptom_when_assumed: probe reads a different Redis and reports a missing Session

invariants.rule: Swagger uses the configured discovery URL while logs/errors/status/debug never reveal SSO secrets or credentials.

proposed_cases.name: swagger openidconnect scheme uses configured issuer discovery
proposed_cases.then: scheme and secured routes match runtime configuration

proposed_cases.name: sso failures redact every credential marker
proposed_cases.given: unique secret code verifier and token markers
proposed_cases.when: callback refresh logout fail and output is inspected
